value.rationale: This is a natural one-parameter deformation between the four-site equilateral norm (a classical Banach root-polytope model) and the four-cycle norm (a 3D Hanner case). The sharp entire volume-product law reveals that the equilateral point is not locally maximal: the product first increases strictly to a nontrivial algebraic parameter before decreasing to the Hanner minimum. The precise phase profile answers a concrete Mahler-type extremal question not determined by known global four-point lower bounds and gives an explicit dual geometric mechanism via capped octahedra.
